newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangshen Railway FY96 full results.
newsitem.headline: Guangshen Railway FY96 full results.

text.p: (Expressed in thousands of Renminbi, except per share data)

NOTES: 1) TURNOVER - Railroad revenues recognised when services performed. Revenues from other businesses include sales aboard trains and in stations of food, beverages and other merchandise and revenues from operating restaurants in major stations. Sales aboard trains and in stations of food, beverages and merchandise are recognised upon delivery.
Revenues from operating restaurants are recognized when services are rendered. Revenues are net of turnover tax.

2) TAXATION - Enterprises established in Shenzhen Special Economic Zone subject to income tax at a reduced rate of 15% as compared with the standard rate for PRC companies of 33%. Shenzhen Municipal Tax Bureau has confirmed the company is subject to reduced tax rate of 15% starting in 1996.
No deferred taxation was recorded for the year, as there were no material timing differences.

3) RESERVES - According to company law of the PRC and company's Articles of Association, when distributing net profit each year, Company shall set aside 10% of its net profit determined in accordance with PRC GAAP for statutory common revenue reserve fund (except where the fund has reached 50% of the Company's registered share capital) and 5% to 10% for the statutory common welfare fund. Reserves cannot be used for purposes other than those for which they are created and are not distributable as cash dividends.

When the statutory common revenue reserve fund is not sufficient to make up for any losses from previous years, current year net profit shall be used to make good the losses before allocations are set aside for the statutory common revenue reserve fund or the statutory common welfare fund.
Statutory common welfare fund is used for the collective welfare of the staff and workers of the Group.

Statutory common revenue reserve fund may be converted into share capital provided it is approved by a resolution at a shareholders' general meeting and the balance of the statutory common revenue reserve fund does not fall below 25% of the registered share capital. Company may either distribute new shares in proportion to the number of shares held by shareholders, or increase the par value of each share.
4) EPS - Computed by dividing consolidated profit attributable to shareholders by the weighted average number of shares outstanding during the year of about 3,808,894,000.
Pro forma EPS for prior year calculated assuming State-owned Domestic Shares issued in connection with the Restructuring were outstanding during the prior year.
Full company name is Guangshen Railway Co Ltd.
